name: Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd is an energy firm primarily engaged in the coal and coke sector, serving both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its core activities encompass the mining and distribution of various coal types, including thermal, coking, anthracite, and semi-anthracite. Additionally, the company extends its operations into the shipping and transportation domain. Established in 2009, its headquarters are situated in Taiyuan, China, and it operates as a subsidiary of Shanxi Coal Imp.&Exp.Group Co.,Ltd.
